newsitem.title: USA: WebTV in deal with Sun JavaSoft unit.
newsitem.headline: WebTV in deal with Sun JavaSoft unit.

text.p: WebTV Networks Inc said it agreed with JavaSoft, a unit of Sun Microsystems Inc, to develop PersonalJava application programming interfaces (APIs).
The interfaces are a new Java programming environment for the consumer electronics market that was announced Wednesday at the JavaOne conference in San Francisco.

WebTV Networks said it is the first company to license PersonalJava and the two companies plan to define "Java for TV," television-specific extensions to the PersonalJava APIs, in conjunction with the Internet television industry and content developers.
